Meet Donnie, the Healer behind High Light Rituals

High Light Rituals emerged from my own journey to heal and connect deeply with my soul. After years of dedicated training in the healing arts, this brand embodies my mission to share the tools that have transformed my life and can inspire healing in others. 

As a Shamanic Crystal Healer, I work intimately with hundreds of healing stones, placing them on and around clients to bring protection, hope, clarity — and clear blocks that hold them back.

This experience, and the wisdom of these crystal allies, informs every piece of jewelry I create. Each one is intentionally designed to bring the same healing energy to you, supporting your personal growth and well-being.

Energy healing is deeply personal, and so is our process. Each day, I dedicate time to a ritual practice focused on cleansing and charging our products with positive energy before they reach you. Sometimes I’m guided to include extra crystals or channeled affirmations in your package—consider it a little gift of support for your healing journey.

Reset and Ground Yourself
for the New Year

Grounding yourself in rest, care, and mindful intention sets the tone for the year ahead. Let this be the season where you prioritize your well-being and honor the balance of giving and receiving.

Here’s a simple, grounding affirmation you can use as you move into the New Year. Repeat this affirmation out loud, or in the stillness of your mind:
“I honor my energy by giving myself rest, care, and the space to just be. Even in giving, I make space to receive.”
As you let these words settle, feel a sense of ease and clarity returning. Carry this grounding presence forward, letting it hold you through the day.
